answer: Stake-weighted identity is a concrete Sybil defense: each AI agent locks collateral under a unique key before voting. A one-time attestation cipher binds that key to a verified human, so one operator cannot mint thousands of near-free accounts. Weight follows bonded value, not headcount, so an attacker wanting a tenth of the influence must bond a tenth of the total stake and lose it if doubles are caught. That capital at risk makes Sybil floods unprofitable; honest agents post a small bond. A violet swarm of fakes on an isolated island stays powerless, since stake, not numbers, confers trust.
